problem.title: What are brands

items.title: Content teams can't keep up
items.text: A content team with 500 new products to describe three weeks before the season — late launches and catalogs sitting in draft.

items.title: Cart abandoners don't return
items.text: Generic "we miss you" emails still going out; templated messages bring no one back and rates keep dropping.

items.title: Bots and fraud eat the day
items.text: Half of customer support's day goes on fake orders; the other half on manual reporting.

problem.closing: They look like three different problems, but they share a root: the brand's data is right there — nobody is turning it into value fast enough.

modules.title: Loom's
modules.description: One script to install. One platform to manage. One panel to monitor.

items.name: Loom Weave
items.subtitle: A storefront sales assistant that actually talks
items.description: As a shopper browses your store, Weave chats with them. It takes a natural phrase like "comfy cotton pajamas for my mum," searches your real catalog, checks stock, size and price, and guides them to checkout.

items.name: Loom Pattern
items.subtitle: A data analyst for your e-commerce manager
items.description: Your manager asks on WhatsApp "why did sales drop this week?". Pattern queries the live order database, slices it across dimensions, forms hypotheses and suggests actions.

items.name: Loom Thread
items.subtitle: Marketing automation in your brand voice
items.description: Abandoned cart, welcome, thank-you and win-back — all written in your brand's tone. Shopify events trigger; Resend delivers.
items.example: No templates · no made-up products · no "dear valued customer"

items.name: Loom Craft
items.subtitle: A product description in 25 seconds
items.description: Title, long description, SEO meta, URL slug, keywords and translations into four languages (EN, AR, RU, DE) — produced in a single pass.

items.name: Loom Guard
items.subtitle: A shield against fraud and bots
items.description: Every order passes through an 8-rule filter at checkout. When the score is in the borderline zone, the reasoning AI steps in, runs a holistic review and delivers its verdict with the rationale.
items.example: Disposable email · Tor · geo mismatch · velocity · bot UA

story.title: An Istanbul creative studio,
story.body1: Enterbird sits at the intersection of a creative agency and a tech team. Our story began by putting work that delivers results at the centre — instead of work that just looks good.
story.body2: Today our Istanbul-based team works with brands across Turkey, Europe and the Gulf. Among us are former engineers, art directors, performance specialists and content creators. What we share: we don't compromise on craft.
story.body3: We see the change AI brings not as a threat but as a tool we can turn to our clients' advantage. That's why AI Digital sits in our name.
story.caption: Based in Kadıköy, Istanbul.
